items.title: OONI Probe measures censorship anywhere
items.oneliner: Installable desktop and mobile probe that tests blocked sites, app reachability, and network interference with public real-time results.

items.title: Filesystem benchmark compares modern CoW stacks
items.oneliner: Runnable benchmark suite compares Btrfs, ZFS, bcachefs, ext4, and xfs with fio, latency percentiles, and corruption checks.

items.title: Quarkdown turns Markdown into programmable publishing
items.oneliner: GitHub repo adds functions, variables, and multi-format output to Markdown for books, papers, and presentations.

items.title: Interactive DSP primer teaches Fourier visually
items.oneliner: Hands-on tutorial explains sampling, aliasing, and DFT with interactive visuals that make signal processing immediately intuitive.

items.title: Readable PHP tests use nonbreaking spaces
items.oneliner: Practical walkthrough shows how to name PHPUnit tests as full sentences without breaking tooling or editor support.

items.title: Shell scripting guide builds command fluency
items.oneliner: Concrete tutorial shows how to combine shell tools into scripts that automate repetitive tasks and replace GUI workflows.

items.title: Notion explains CRDT-based concurrent editing
items.oneliner: Deep implementation writeup shows how block-based CRDTs prevent lost edits during offline and multi-user collaboration.

items.title: OpenGOAL revives Jak with native tooling
items.oneliner: Open-source x86-64 port and toolchain lets developers mod, inspect, and run the first three Jak games natively.

items.title: Brood War Bench tests coding models
items.oneliner: Benchmark report compares frontier coding models in RTS play and exposes where agent coordination still fails badly.

items.title: Typst gains serious technical publishing features
items.oneliner: Version 0.15 adds variable fonts and stronger technical docs support for teams considering a faster LaTeX alternative.
